declared_source: The experts_ragged.cu hash recorded when the LakyFx 1.2.8 prefill assets were imported.
change: Adds an opt-in TF_EXL3_W_RANGE16 compile path: HI16 grouped MMA templates whose weight ring uses dynamic shared memory. Without that define the preprocessor keeps the original kernel code.

served_cubin.note: The LakyFx 1.2.8 build, shipped unchanged. SOURCE.json lists it as measured_cubin_sha256 and the release manifest loads it through TF_DS_PREFILL_RAGGED_CUBIN. A local nvcc 13.4.92 build of either source differs from it.

why_source_json_keeps_the_declared_hash: SOURCE.json is part of the vendored engine tree whose file hashes release/build-verification.json records (source_manifest_sha256 6a62197578751aed5104f8ef3676674bc40097bca484562b7af916b675e937b4).
